questions.stem: Name one difference between plant and animal cells.
questions.answer: Plant cells have cell walls, chloroplasts, and large vacuoles while animal cells do not.

questions.stem: Write the word equation for photosynthesis.
Why are mitochondria important for cell function?
questions.answer: Mitochondria produce ATP, the energy currency of the cell, through cellular respiration.

questions.stem: What is the function of ribosomes in a cell?
questions.answer: Ribosomes synthesize proteins by reading mRNA and assembling amino acids.

questions.stem: Explain the difference between diffusion and active transport.
questions.answer: Diffusion is passive movement of substances from high to low concentration, while active transport requires energy to move substances against the concentration gradient.
DNA is a double helix structure consisting of two strands of nucleotides connected by hydrogen bonds between complementary base pairs (A-T, C-G).
